aggressive_mode_router_observations.key_observation: NOVEL: aggressive mode tried haiku-as-coder on 2 nodes for a tabular task. Previously haiku was reserved for non-code roles. The successful nodes (4,5) using haiku-coder still completed with above_median score → suggests haiku-coder is viable for simple tabular tasks at extremely low cost.

cheapest_valid_in_campaign: $8.18 — cheapest valid submission in the whole 60+ run campaign across all dates. Tabular tasks with haiku-driven coding are an unexplored cost frontier.
interpretation: Spaceship-titanic is a Kaggle starter tabular binary classification — agent-friendly task surface. Aggressive's haiku-coder exploration paid off here: cheap AND valid AND above_median. For tabular family, this is a meaningful new data point about the haiku capacity.
